profile.headline: Uber TL, Senior Software Engineer at Google

positions.title: Software Design Engineer in Test
positions.description: Worked for Windows Update Services Team where I developed software that tested and assured the quality of the Windows Update system.

positions.title: Software Design Engineer in Test 2
positions.description: Worked for the Mobile Internet Explorer team, creating software tools to assure the quality of the official internet browser application that runs on Windows Mobile. Automated tests focused heavily on UI however also included some API tests, e.g. testing JavaScript engine API.

projects.title: Puzzle Charms
projects.description: Match-3 style Facebook game. Front-end gameplay, tools, and localization programmed using ActionScript 3.0, back-end Facebook integration, server-client bridge agent programmed using PHP JavaScript/jQuery. Reached 1.4 million DAU.
